about: Model verdicts on source against tree for adl-2026 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The lead-in sentence for the second list in B9 is a separate line that applies to the whole paragraph, but the tree joins it to the end of item b of the first list.
findings.evidence: source: "This should include the following as appropriate." (own line) / tree: "...standards given in paragraph 5.77. This should include the following as appropriate."

findings.problem: The two short entries on this page are mixed line by line with the two-column 'List of Approved Documents' text from another page.
findings.evidence: source: "Assessment Procedure for Dwellings [2005]" / tree: "Assessment Procedure for Dwellings [2005] The following documents have been published to give guidance on how to meet the Building"

findings.problem: The RICS document is put under an invented heading 'Approved Document A Approved Document L' and not under the RICS heading.
findings.evidence: source: "Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS) (www.rics.org) Code of Measuring Practice [2015]" / tree: "Code of Measuring Practice [2015] Structure Energy and greenhouse gas emissions Volume 1: Dwellings"

findings.problem: The tree gives this page many Approved Document headings and texts (A to T and 7) that are not printed on it.
findings.evidence: tree: "Approved Document B", "Fire safety Approved Document L Volume 1: Dwellings Energy and greenhouse gas emissions Volume 2: Buildings other than dwellings"

findings.problem: The RICS web address is run together with a sentence from the Approved Documents list that is not on this page.

findings.problem: The one-column regulation box is given as one row with two cells, split in the middle of sub-paragraph (bb); all the words are kept.

findings.problem: The one-column regulation box is given as one row with two cells, split between the label (cc) and its text; all the words are kept.

findings.problem: The formula in paragraph 1.11 is printed as a fraction, but the tree runs the top and bottom together with no division sign and with the subscripts flattened into the words.

findings.evidence: source: first printed row is "Electrically powered heat pumps(1)" / tree: columns "Low carbon heat source"

findings.problem: The closing paragraph of 2.5, which applies to items (a) to (d), is joined onto list item d.
findings.evidence: tree: "d. A list of specifications used in the as-built calculations, ... design stage calculations. Building control bodies can accept evidence of (a) to (d) above"

findings.problem: In 2.6 the separate lines EITHER and OR and the closing guidance sentence are joined onto the lead-in and onto items a.iii and b.iii.

findings.problem: The column names of Table 3.3 have words that are not printed, and the two printed value columns (a) Threshold and (b) Improved are joined into one cell; the values themselves are right.

findings.problem: In note 1 of Table 3.5 the exponent 0.4 on V is flattened onto the line, so the formula no longer reads as V to the power 0.4.
The page prints no rule between the last two light source types, so the value 80 appears to cover both, but the grid makes the colour rendering index line a separate row with an empty value.
findings.evidence: source: "Tuneable LED devices 80 / Light source with colour rendering index greater than or equal to 95" (one cell block, value 80) / tree: ["Light source with colour rendering index greater than or equal to 95", ""]
